entries.lead: the ParadeDB platform now requires `pg_search`, not `pg_analytics`
entries.text: Current ParadeDB images no longer ship `pg_analytics`, so the adapter could not connect to them. The supported image is `paradedb/paradedb:0.26.2-pg18` (PostgreSQL 18.6, `pg_search` 0.26.2); the missing-extension error names it, and `latest` is no longer recommended. Servers that only carry `pg_analytics` fail at connection time.
